title: Pakistan Navy Recruitment 2026: Sailor & Officer Guide
metaDescription: Pakistan Navy recruitment 2026: sailor, marine and PN Cadet age limits, education, height and the online application process at joinpaknavy.gov.pk explained.
headline: Pakistan Navy Recruitment 2026: How to Join

sections.title: Sailor recruitment: branches and eligibility
sections.content:
The Pakistan Navy inducts sailors twice a year, in Batch A and Batch B, through online registration at joinpaknavy.gov.pk. The main branches are Technical, Marine, Naval Police, and support trades such as Chef, Steward, Musician and Sanitary Worker. Sailor Batch A-2026 registration was open in late 2026.

Technical sailors need Matric Science with at least 65% marks, must be aged 16 to 20 years, and stand at least 5 feet 4 inches tall. Marines need Matric Science with 60% marks, must be aged 17 to 21 years, and must be at least 5 feet 6 inches tall with 6/6 eyesight. Naval Police need Matric Science or Arts with 60% marks, aged 16 to 20 years, at least 5 feet 7 inches tall.

sections.title: PN Cadet: the officer route after FSc
sections.content:
Young men with FSc Pre-Engineering, ICS or A-levels in Physics, Maths and Chemistry or Computer Science, with at least 60% marks, can join as PN Cadets. Candidates must be aged 16 years 6 months to 21 years and unmarried, with a minimum height of 5 feet 4 inches.

PN Cadets train for two years at the Pakistan Naval Academy in Karachi, starting as midshipmen and commissioning as sub-lieutenants. The course combines naval science, seamanship, leadership and physical training, and graduates go on to serve in the Operations, Supply, Engineering or other branches of the Navy.

sections.title: Short Service Commission for graduates
sections.content:
University graduates with a 16-year degree such as a BS, BE, MBBS or MBA can join directly as officers through the Short Service Commission (SSC). The general requirement is a minimum 2.5 CGPA or 60% marks from an HEC-recognised university, with age limits of 22 to 27 years and above depending on the branch.

Women with 16 years of education can join through the SSC in branches such as Information Technology, Public Relations, Education and the Medical Branch, as General Duty Medical Officers or specialists. Female officers need a minimum height of 5 feet, and the M Cadet scheme offers a separate route for MBBS students in their fourth or fifth year.

sections.title: Selection, tests and training
sections.content:
Selection begins with online registration, followed by an entry test of intelligence and academic subjects, a medical examination and an interview. Sailors who pass go to the New Entry Schools for basic training, while officers train at the Pakistan Naval Academy, where discipline, drill, academics and sea training are combined.

Marines, the Navy's amphibious infantry, receive additional training for coastal operations, base defence and boarding operations, and help protect key assets such as Gwadar Port. Across all branches, promotion follows courses, sea service and performance, with experienced sailors able to rise through the rates to senior non-commissioned ranks.

faqs.q: What is the age limit to join the Pakistan Navy as a sailor?
faqs.a: Sailor age limits depend on the branch. Technical sailors must be 16 to 20 years old, Marines 17 to 21 years, and Naval Police 16 to 20 years, with the age counted on the date given in the course advertisement. Other trades such as MTD drivers allow up to 24 years, and Naib Khateeb up to 35 years.

faqs.q: What education do I need to join the Pakistan Navy?
faqs.a: Technical sailors need Matric Science with at least 65% marks, while Marines and Naval Police need Matric with 60% marks. PN Cadets need FSc Pre-Engineering or ICS with 60% marks in Physics, Maths and Chemistry or Computer Science. SSC officers need a 16-year degree with at least 2.5 CGPA or 60% marks.

faqs.q: How do I apply for Pakistan Navy recruitment 2026?
faqs.a: Apply online at joinpaknavy.gov.pk when registration is open; sailor inductions run twice a year as Batch A and Batch B. Complete the online form, download the roll number slip, and appear for the entry test at the nearest Pakistan Navy recruitment centre on the date given. Always confirm dates on the official website, because each batch has its own schedule.

faqs.q: Can women join the Pakistan Navy?
faqs.a: Yes, women with 16 years of education can join as commissioned officers through the Short Service Commission in branches such as Information Technology, Public Relations, Education and the Medical Branch. Female officers need a minimum height of 5 feet. Women cannot join directly after FSc; the graduate SSC route is the main entry for them.
